subject: default marker covariates and window cM for cim

messages.author: 651db60946af6cea
messages.subject: default marker covariates and window cM for cim
parts:
What are the default marker covariates and window size cM when using cim and not specifying the marker covariate and window arguments.

example:

example_defaults <- cim(data, pheno.col = 3, method=c("em"), map.function=c("kosambi"))

vs

example_with_specifications <-  cim(M3, pheno.col = 3, n.marcovar=3, window=10, method=c("em"), map.function=c("kosambi")) 

Best,
Sean

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: default marker covariates and window cM for cim
parts:
You can see the default values for the arguments by typing

    args(cim)

or in the help file for the function,

    help(cim)

For cim(), 3 marker covariates and window size of 10 cM.

karl
